acceptance: Proposed: frozen standalone and consumer typechecks plus all task static criteria. Static evidence only; no runtime proof. Ambiguous criteria invalidate the affected score until a new version is frozen.

criteria.rule: Calls the real Graph.topology() API on the supplied graph; does not manually filter describe(), reconstruct nodes or change the graph.
Retains the complete library topology including subgraphs and annotations, without adding runtime node fields. It may return the snapshot directly.
Does not infer code equality, business-result equality or effect permission from pure topology; does not call this a privacy-safe export of arbitrary metadata.
Uses undefined and level discrimination; returns exactly one correctly tagged report per item; no truthiness test losing counter zero.
Preserves counter, cid and prev, including null; does not reinterpret cid as a source revision or invent a disabled hash.
Explains content hash versus source/authorization; advanceNodeVersion can increment counter even when content hash remains equal. Does not claim any equality proves effect permission.
Collects values from ok results only, even if issues exist; error contributes its primary error before additional issues.
Preserves ordering, duplicates and object references; does not mutate input arrays/objects or substitute fabricated facts. Empty input yields empty arrays.
Distinguishes passive result/issue facts from protocol ERROR and run termination; retryable metadata alone does not authorize retry or execute effects.
